article.title: Sensex, Nifty today: Nifty 50 falls 0.39% to 22,600.00, Sensex down 0.17% | 23 October 2026
article.dek: The Nifty 50 closed at 22,600.00. NSE index scoreboard, sector heatmap, breadth, top movers and FII/DII flows.

visualSpec.fiiDiiNote: NSE provisional figures for the cash market, in ₹ crore.

reportTakeaways: The Nifty 50 fell 0.39%; 450 of 501 Nifty 500 stocks declined, and small caps fell more (-2.94%).
reportWatch: Crude oil prices and West Asia tensions, which drove Friday's selling
Paras Healthcare and Jio Platforms IPO allotment on Monday 26 October; both are due to list on Wednesday 28 October
Whether foreign and domestic institutions keep buying after both were net buyers on Friday
India VIX, after its rise on Friday
body: The Nifty 50 fell 87.65 points, or 0.39%, to close at 22,600.00 on Friday, 23 October 2026, according to NSE closing data. The Sensex fell 0.17% to 73,123.83. Bank Nifty lost 1.16% to 54,287.35.

Why the market moved | Upstox reported that investors turned cautious on rising crude oil prices amid escalating geopolitical tensions in West Asia, with concerns over potential supply disruptions. Oil-related stocks traded lower, and declines in FMCG, oil and gas and consumer durable stocks also weighed on the benchmark indices; every NSE sector index ended the session in the red.

More data | Scroll up for the full NSE index scoreboard, sector heatmap, Nifty 500 breadth, top gainers and losers and FII/DII flows. For more, see the Nifty 50 page and the FII/DII data page on TotalMarket.
